column1: # Rare Arbëresh and Arvanitika words quoted in studies: Perta, Ciccolone and Canù on Villa Badessa, Studia Linguistica Italo-Albanica, the Albanica article on Jochalas's Arvanitika works, Turano on San Nicola dell'Alto, Matranga in Korpus im Text, and the Padua thesis of Picari.
